description: This source file defines the internal sealed class 'CounterAggregatorGroup' which manages a group of 'CounterAggregator' instances indexed by 'TagList'. It provides methods to find or create aggregators, add measurements with varying tag combinations, and collect non-zero measurements.

classes.name: CounterAggregatorGroup
classes.description: Manages a collection of 'CounterAggregator' instances keyed by 'TagList', allowing measurement aggregation and collection.

methods.name: FindOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves existing 'CounterAggregator' for a given 'TagList', or creates and adds a new one if it does not exist.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Overloaded methods to add measurements with varying numbers of tag name-value pairs or a 'TagList' to the appropriate 'CounterAggregator'.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Yields 'Measurement<long>' for each 'CounterAggregator' with non-zero value.
